notes.title: Train Jumble on Kickstarter!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/c385ea50a616717356d6220d75030d6323013c40.png"][/img][/p][p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]We have been developing Train Jumble for roughly one year now and have a big announcement to make.[/p][p]We want to go to the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/emergoentertainment/train-jumble"]Kickstarter[/url] route to finish our game.[/p][p]Our demo already let's you experience Train Jumble’s gameplay for many hours. But the game still lacking content to warrant a full release in our opinion.[/p][p]We want to at least add[/p][p]•	2 routes across Europe[/p][p]•	8 new passenger types[/p][p]•	6 new modules [/p][p]•	a feature that lets you add more train cars adds effects to the train cars which should enable more build variety.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/987e3c0267287ca9115eabe6d744f7d494091374.png"][/img][/p][p]Each route we'll have 14 or 15 towns you can travel too and 30 collectible postcards. We also need to localize the game.[/p][p]Adding this content won't be possible with our current budget. The FFF Bavaria has graciously supported train jumbles development with €80,000 and we have invested €50,000 and its development ourselves.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/14315d8b3c6163dbf989f3e03c7f9d4236925ac8.jpg"][/img][/p][p]But to finish the game more investment is needed but a strained publishing market has prohibited us from finding funding.[/p][p]We are willing to invest more of our own money into developing the game, but we need your support to complete the budget. We are looking to earn €25,000 from the [url="https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/emergoentertainment/train-jumble"]Kickstarter campaign[/url] and looking to invest €25,000 to finish the game. The cool thing about Kickstarter is that we can show you more of our ideas and if you're really interested, we get to develop more features.[/p][p]Starting today you can follow our pre launch page on Kickstarter we are looking to gain at least 1000 followers there before we launch our campaign.[/p][h1]Train Jumble @ Gamescom[/h1][p]If you're at Gamescom there is a really cool opportunity for you to win an amazing prize if you follow our Kickstarter page. With the help of plush manufacturer Heunec we have created a 1,5m tall plush giraffe that you can win. There is also 5 Buzzy plushies from our previous game Fireside available to win.[/p][p]To join the giveaway you need to visit our booth at Gamescom and show us that you followed our Kickstarter page.[/p][p]We are doing the Kickstarter not just to secure funding but also to verify your interest in our game. We believe there is great potential in Train Jumble and with your support we can finish this awesome game about traveling Europe, managing your passengers and building your train.[/p][p]Thank you for your support up until this point and we really hope we can count on your further support on Kickstarter.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Ready to ride! Train Jumble demo is live now!
notes.notes:
It’s demo launch time! We are very excited to be part of the cozy & family friendly steam fest and to be taking off with our demo for Train Jumble!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/2f4e799a6d91653f3a84568da5b8c3a7c92f16ed.jpg[/img]

In the demo you will be travelling our home region of Bavaria in Germany on three routes which will also be the starting area of the game. Using modifiers you will be able to make passengers more demanding up the challenge of completing the route.

We’re super thankful for all the feedback you provided during our playtest and managed to improve the game because of it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/e8dba32779ec2eaa28ab7bd078eb9862e067ed4b.gif[/img]

The most important take away from the tests for us was implementing part of the game’s progression and spreading out the difficulty curve by adding a balatro-like stakes system.

We also added more systems to the game such as modules that generate money.

Unlock postcards of real sights from our home region; who knows – maybe you’ll even find some cool travel destinations for when you’re visiting Bavaria!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/54f8111a4943231f6462f568e2c3767ca42c65e3.gif[/img]

The demo will only be available in English for now, however we intend to localize the game to Chinese, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish, French and German for release and will try to localize the demo as soon as possible.

[url=https://discord.gg/QRhHR6X]Join our Discord[/url] to stay up to date. There are plenty of new announcements coming! Let’s see if we can get a hype train rolling.

notes.title: Train Jumble Playtest Update
notes.notes:
On February 19th we made a first version of Train Jumble available to an audience beyond our small studio from Bayreuth / Germany. So firstly, it's time to say...
[h2]Thank you![/h2]
Thank you very much for playtesting our first public version of Train Jumble. 256 people actively played the demo spending over 160 hours playtesting Train Jumble. We're a small studio with a small game but this is still something to be proud about! Thank you for spending your time, helping us make our game better!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/e8dba32779ec2eaa28ab7bd078eb9862e067ed4b.gif[/img]
Thank you for the 100 e-mails and discord messages you sent us with many constructive suggestions and ideas!
[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
With that said, we're introducing a first patch for the Train Jumble playtest and will give access to anyone who was still waiting!

We're introducing the following updates to the game:
[list]
[*] Unlimited action mode is now the default
[*] Each mission now has a reduced map, to make the routes more interesting. 
[*] Added option to sell items in your inventory
[*] Improved "next to X" desires for sideway seats
[*] Increased the AOE of the window-module
[*] Added a motion sickness mode that freezes the train in position (check the options to activate it)
[*] Added edge pan to move the camera on top of the normal WASD and Mouse wheel movement (can be disabled in the options)
[*] The next desires UI at the top, when in station, now only show what you are missing in your train and how many passengers want to get on your train. There is no penalty if not every passenger fits on the train. You can hover the UI to get more information.
[*] Added missing main menu music
[*] Added unlock counter to the main menu
[*] lots of small bug fixes and usability improvements
[/list]
We're curious how these changes affect gameplay and what you think! So head over to our Discord to discuss the changes and give us feedback!
[url=https://discord.gg/QRhHR6X][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/7b22dd97e0946b229f326483358643560110ee43.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Game Announcement: Train Jumble
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/873c7faf367dda025116f8059ede38e01c5614d4.png[/img]

We're super excited to announce our second game [b]Train Jumble[/b] a game where you travel Europe in your self-furnished train while making sure all your passengers are happy with their seats!

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
Train Jumble offers entertaining, non-violent, non-time-critical gameplay in a humorous setting. You have to move passengers so that they are happy with their seats and can add modules to your train at stations to make the journey more comfortable, more fun or more productive, depending on what the passengers want.
[list]
[*] Furnish your train
[*] Manage passengers
[*] Buy upgrades
[*] Travel Europe
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45490298/40dbe63e6240f9458b77554da905c8999dba5dc9.gif[/img]

[h2]Public playtest February 19th[/h2]
You can [b]sign up[/b] for a first public playtest [b]starting today[/b]! Simply head to our steam page and click the button next to "wishlist" (wishlisting is very welcome too, of course ;) )
We're looking forward to share more updates about the game in the future and especially looking forward to your feedback from the playtest!
